module: Computation of the preview data for the rally editor's "AI Competitors" tab. From the general parameters, the reference time and a competitor's traits (skill, consistency, risk, in [0,1]), it computes the outcome mixture density over 500 samples: a first pass over a wide range, an automatic zoom onto the area where the mixture is significant, then a second pass over the zoomed range. It also returns the weight of each outcome and the y-axis maximum. Uses aiCompetitorsEditorModel.mixtureDensityTimes (hence gameplay/rally/aiCompetitors).
notes: Wide range: from 0.65 × reference to min(reference × max_time_multiplier_vs_reference [2.35 default], reference × 2.8).

The zoom keeps the area where the mixture exceeds 2% of the peak, with a 10% margin (at least 1% of the wide range) and a minimum width of 5.5% of the wide range; the zoom is only kept if it covers less than 90% of the wide range.
Only the first 4 outcomes (excluding DNF) have density components.

narrowTimeRangeFromMixture.desc: Narrows the time range to the area where the mixture density exceeds 2% of its peak, with margin and minimum width. Returns the wide range unchanged if the peak is almost zero (≤ 1e-30), if the wide range is zero or if the zoom keeps more than 90% of the range.

densityResult.desc: Result of mixtureDensityTimes: mixture, times, sampleCount.

broadTimeLo.desc: Lower bound of the wide range (seconds).

broadTimeHi.desc: Upper bound of the wide range (seconds).

computeVisualization.desc: Computes everything needed to draw the preview: outcome weights, densities over the zoomed range, weighted components of the first 4 outcomes, y-axis maximum and time bounds.

input.desc: {general (general parameters), referenceSec (reference time in s), skillUnit, consistencyUnit, riskUnit (each in [0,1])}.
